## Checklist

- [ ] It does one thing, and is small enough to review in one sitting.
- [ ] A fix has a test that fails without it; a feature has tests for what it does.
- [ ] `ctest` passes (`cd build && ctest --output-on-failure`).
- [ ] `tools/lint.sh` passes.
- [ ] The manual under `docs/` is updated if what users see changed.
- [ ] No personal data, credentials, or assets I do not have the right to share.
